With its head-office in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, CWT Sitos was founded on 1 July 2002.

Young of age but with years and years of experience in managing soft commodity logistics.

The company offers a wide range of logistical services, focusing on soft commodities mainly but not limited between Africa, South America, Caribbean and Europe. Specialiteiten :
Warehousing, Tendering, Weighing and sampling, Stevedoring, Quality control, Inspection services, Shipping, forwarding, Transport and distribution, Customs clearance, And more!
